name: Antarctopelta
sum: Antarctopelta is a Late Cretaceous ankylosaur from James Ross Island, Antarctica, the first dinosaur named from that continent.
holotype: MLP 86-X-28-1, the only known material — Snow Hill Island Formation, James Ross Island, found in 1986.
material: Holotype only; the femur is estimated at about 30 cm long.
biology: Teeth are proportionately large for an ankylosaur, the largest about 10 mm across.
author: Salgado and Gasparini 2006
